definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese-style accommodation with tatami rooms, futons, and often includes meals and hot spring baths.

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}{旅館|りょかん}に{泊|と}まりたいです。
examples.english: I want to stay at a hot spring inn.

examples.japanese: この{旅館|りょかん}は{料理|りょうり}がおいしいです。
examples.english: The food at this inn is delicious.

examples.japanese: {旅館|りょかん}では{浴衣|ゆかた}を{着|き}ます。
examples.english: At the inn, you wear a yukata.

examples.japanese: {旅館|りょかん}の{予約|よやく}は{早|はや}めにしたほうがいいですよ。
examples.english: You should make reservations at the inn early.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}で{旅館|りょかん}に{泊|と}まって、{温泉|おんせん}と{日本|にほん}{料理|りょうり}を{楽|たの}しみました。
examples.english: We stayed at a Japanese inn with our family and enjoyed the hot springs and Japanese cuisine.

notes:
{旅館|りょかん} is a traditional Japanese inn offering a culturally immersive lodging experience.

TYPICAL FEATURES:
- {畳|たたみ} rooms with {布団|ふとん}
- {浴衣|ゆかた} provided for guests
- {懐石|かいせき}{料理|りょうり} (multi-course meals)
- {温泉|おんせん} or {大浴場|だいよくじょう} (communal baths)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {温泉|おんせん}{旅館|りょかん}: hot spring inn
- {旅館|りょかん}に{泊|と}まる: to stay at an inn
- {旅館|りょかん}を{予約|よやく}する: to book an inn

COMPARE:
- {旅館|りょかん}: traditional Japanese inn
- ホテル: Western-style hotel
- {民宿|みんしゅく}: family-run guesthouse (simpler)
- {ペンション}: pension (Western-style B&B)
